tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shrī he ru ka gu ra we/gnyug ma
༄༅/ /dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shrī he ru ka gu ra we/gnyug ma

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shrī he ru ka gu ra we/

gnyug ma gshis kyi he ru ka /rang rig ngo bor mjal phyag gis/ /btud nas phrin las snying po'i gzhung*/ /mdzes byed rin chen phra tshom spel/ /'dir gter chen rgyal po o rgyan gling pa'i zab gter gyi gsang ba'i cha shas mkhas grub gter chen yongs kyi khyu mchog /pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i yang gter gyi chos sde las byon pa'i rgyun gyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i byang bu nyams su len par 'dod pas/ nyer mkho'i zur 'debs 'ga' zhig spel ba la/ thog mar tshig bdun dang/ sku gsum gsol 'debs rjes/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung gi mthar rol mo brgya brdung gis byin gyis brlab/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis nam mkha' las skar chen thang la lhag pa bzhin du/ spyi dpal chen po khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i lha sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gar dgu'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol stabs su bsnams shing*/ dpal dang dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis ru dra nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la 'gying ba/ de'i pang du sbyor yul dmar mo gri thod 'dzin cing*/ khrag 'thung ma'i cha lugs can gyis 'khyud pa'i skur gyur par bltas la/ bsang chu'am las bum bsgrub pa ni/ dung zhal lam bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang ba ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsreg gtor bkrus/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du'am/ las bum gyi nang du pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig ljang nag yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag g.yas rgya gram dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas can/ bskal me'i gzi byin 'bar zhing*/ ye shes kyi me 'od 'phro ba'i klong du zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis 'gying ba/ thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba la/

bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bskul bas/ 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas shing rgyal ba'i byin brlabs bsdus/ sngags phreng dang sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil zhing bde ba'i 'od zer gyis/ lha 'od du zhu nas 'dres pas/ zeg ma gang la 'thor bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun 'joms par nus pa'i bdud rtsir gyur par bltas la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ /ces brgya rtsa bzlas pas nus ldan du bsgrub cing*/ gnas yo rnams la bsang gtor bya/ gzhi gnas kyi bdag por gtor ma bsngo ba dmigs bsal dgos na/ dkar gtor gser skyems bcas las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho lan gsum gyis brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa mgron bkug /s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe tra pa lañtsa na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐: sa bdag lha klu 'byung po'i tshogasaḥ mchod gtor bzang po 'di bzhes la: sa 'di bdag la stsal nas kyang : dge zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol: zhes pas phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha sa dkar gtor gser skyems bcas sbyin la gshegs/ bgegs gtor sha chang gis brgyan pa bshams te/ yi ge gsum gyis sbyang*/ yid mthun kyi snod du gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ so so'i spyod yul du 'dzad med kyi gter chen por 'char bar gyur par bsams la spel/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis zag pa med pa'i rdzas 'chi sos kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron bkug /sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa

sogs/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ h+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po nas 'byung ba'i bka' bsgo/ hūm̐: nga ni 'khor 'das spyi dpal sogs/ drag sngags ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: rgyal chen sde bzhi sa sogs gyer mthar/ bka' nan rnam pa bcus mtshams bcad pa'i slad tshogs bsags pa'i yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dpal chen tshom bu nyer gcig gi lha tshogs la/ phyogs dus kyi rtsa gsum srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i sprin phung 'od zer gyi snang bas khyab pa'i klong du dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gsal btab nas/ na moḥ bdag sogs 'gro kun sogs lan gsum mthar/ slar yang snang srid thams cad khyab brdal ye shes gzhir bzhengs kyi 'khor lor bltas la/ hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud sogs/ brda sgo phyag bshags pa dang*/ mchod rdzas byin brlab/ gnas yo byin 'bebs/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum nas brtsams spro na mchod pa zur 'debs ltar btang*/ bsdu na rang gzhung ltar dang*/ gang ltar yang bstod pa rdzogs kyi bar gzhung mthar chags su 'ded/ tshogs mchod lta bu'i spyir btang la dzab¿ sgo dbye bas 'thus shing*/ bsnyen sgrub/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs dzab¿ khang dbye dgos pas/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe 'i mthar/ zhi khro'i spyi sngags la/ phaṭa dzaḥ btags pas/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi go sar mar me gcig las gnyis mched ltar/ ye shes kya ི dkyil 'khor gsal brtan 'od zer gzi brjid 'bar ba/ bdag mdun me ri 'dab 'byar gyi tshul du/ sku gsung thugs dgyes shing*/ rngams pa'i rol gar mtha' yas pas gsal brtan du bzhugs par gyur

par bsams la/ lha sku'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ris med pa'i gdul bya'i snang ngor gang 'dul gzugs su shar ba'i dag dran la bslab cing sems 'dzin/ ngag bzlas kyi skabs su bab pa na/ hūm̐: bdag nyid spyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka ruḥ sogs/ dzab¿ sgo dbye ba'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig tu byas la/ zhi ba spyi dril dang*/ spyi dpal chen po'i sngags sum brgya nas stong rtsa'i bar dang*/ dpal chen nyi shu por de'i bcu cha re/ spyi dril chen mo gtso sngags dang grangs mnyam par bzla zhing*/ rgyas par sgrub chen lta bu'i skabs sngags tshan nyer gnyis po so so'i mthar/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs shwa lo ka'i rjes su/ so so'i dzab¿ la/ ma hā pañtsa sogs btags pas dzab¿ mchod 'bul/ 'bring po ltar na/ zhi ba dang*/ gtso bo spyi dpal chen por dzab¿ mchod re re dang*/ dpal nyi shu spyir gcig /spyi dril mthar gcig bcas 'bul/ shin tu bsdu na/ bzlas pa thams cad grub nas dzab¿ mchod 'bul/ tshe sgrub mi sbyor na/ rak+tas mchod bzhin/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs ldan sogs kyis nga rgyal bskyed pa'i bstod pa bya/ tshe sgrub spro na/ dzab¿ mchod rjes/ rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las 'byung ba/ hūm̐: spyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka sogs kyis ting 'dzin gsal la/ bzlas pa ci nus mthar/ tshe 'gugs pho nya btang ba'i rjes stong tshig la 'jug pa'am/ sgrub chen skabs lta bur ched kyis spro na/ he ru ka dpal tshe yi sogs gsol gdab nas/ dbang blangs ba'i mtha' bar rdzogs par btang zhing*/ thabs shes kyi rdzas la rol pa nyin re bzhin bgyis na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur/ gang ltar yang*/ slar dzab¿ mchod dang*/ rak+ta phyar zhing*/ hūm̐: sku gsung thugs ldan sogs kyi nga rgyal bskyed pas bstod cing yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas pas sngags kyi nus pa brtan par bya/ bka' srung mchod thabs shin tu bsdus pa ltar/

mgon po gnam lcags me 'bar dam can 'dus pa'i byin brlab nas/ bzlas pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ skabs 'dir rang lugs kyi srung ma'i rgyun gtor rigs spro na bya/ skong chog mdor bsdus sbyar bar 'dod na/ grub thob thugs thig las khol byung lta bu gter kha rigs mthun nas blangs te tshogs skong gi 'gros de dag dang bstun dgos pa dang*/ smad las sbyar tshe 'don 'grigs de nyid dang bstun dgos pa bcas skabs thob kyi dmigs phyed pa dgos pa ni khyad par ro/ /dkyus kyi ngag 'don ni/ zhing ngam/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng thabs shes kyi rdzas tshogs par byas la/ gzhung las/ gsol ba gdab/ ces gsungs pas/ tshogs sgrub dang*/ sgrub mchod skabs lta bu/ 'dus pa mang du tshogs pa'i tshe tshogs kyi phrin las gsol gdab ni/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag bcas thal mo sbyar te/ e ma hoḥ e ma hoḥ e ma hoḥ chos dbyings mtha' dbus med pa'i pho brang nas: gang la gang 'dul tshul du skur sprul pa'i: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas dang : bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang : bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha: ston pa rdo rje rgyal po rgyal tshab dang : rgyal theb gzungs ma mched dang lcam dral bcas: bka' srung chos skyong pho nya las mkhan tshogs: 'dus pa rgya mtshor bcas rnams dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir bdag cag rnal 'byor tshogs rnams dang : rdo rje slob dpon gtso mdzad yongs 'dus nas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul zhing : bdag gis gus par mchod cing gsol mchis na: dgyes par skyong zhing thugs rjes longs spyod dam: zhes gsol ba btab la/ ston pa rdo rje rgyal pos gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ hoḥ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gsan du gsolaḥ deng gi gnas dus khyad par can 'di ruḥ

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i spyan snga na: 'byor ldan longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa rnams: 'dus pa'i mched dang lcam dral thams cad kyis: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyang ba dang : dngos grub ma lus myur du thob bya'i phyir: phun sum tshogs par bshams pa 'di dag ni: dgyes pa chen pos rol par gnang bas na: bstab dang 'bul sogs rol par da mdzod cig: a la la ho: zhes pas lan sbyin/ las rdor gyis phyag bcas/ tshogs bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab pa la thugs ga ta da par zhu/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ phrin las nar ma ltar/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'bar ba sogs kyis tshogs rdzas bsang sbyang byin brlab/ spyan 'dren mthar/ phyag sngon 'gros/ tshogs dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba la thugs gta da par zhu/ zhes gsol mthar/ hūm̐: dpal chen bka' 'dus sogs kyis tshogs phud 'bul/ yang phyag bcas/ tshogs bar pa bskang bshags gnang ba la sogs zhu/ hoḥ dpal chen lha tshogs sogs kyis tshogs bar pa phul/ yang phyag bcas/ tshogs tha ma bsgral mchod gnang ba la sogs zhu ba sngon 'gros/ 'gugs pa ni/ g.yab dril lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas/ na mo dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs: yi dam bde gshegs dpal chen bka' 'dus lha: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma rgya mtsho dang : lha sngags ting 'dzin rgyu 'bras bslu ba med: chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa yis: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa'i dam sri'i tshogs: da lta nyid du gzugs byang 'di la khug: ces rtsa ba'i thugs sgrub dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi sgrub khog nas 'byung ba brjod pa'i mthar/ spyi dril gyi sham bur/ nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ nṛ badz+ra aṃ ku shā dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku shā dzaḥ sa gzugs la bkug /pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i pho nya sogs nas/ bsgral bstab rjes/ bskang rdzas nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/

oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa kham̐ gis spel la/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings la sogs bskang bsdus rin chen sil ma bshags pa bcas kyi mthar/ hūm̐: ye shes las grub sogs bka' srung mchod thabs las 'byung ba'i srung ma'i sger skong bshags pa'i mtha' bar btang*/ hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar sogs phrin las bzhin/ sid+dhi hūm̐/ bar gyis bsgral mtha' dngos grub gsol/ hoḥ tshom bu nyer gcig sogs kyis tshogs kyi dngos grub zhus mthar/ las rdor rnams nas thabs shes kyi rdzas btegs te/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan sogs kyis drangs/ len pa pos/ a la la hoḥ brjod/ dpon slob kun gyis/ rin thang med las sogs kyis blangs/ hoḥ phung khams skye mched zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rtsa khams brgyud gsum rig 'dzin dhā ki'i tshogs: dgyes mchod rdo rje bde ba'i tshogs la rol: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: ma hā pū dza a la la hoḥ nang gi sreg blug gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyod cing*/ gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa ji ltar 'dod pa sbyar/ dkyil 'khor pa'i phud lhag stegs zur par zhing lpags bting ba'i khar me tog sogs nyer spyod lngas bskor bshams gyi dbus su mañdzi'i steng dang 'og tu 'dus pa rnams kyi tshogs lhag slob dpon gyi lhag mas mnan pa bkod/ gtsang lhag bdud rtsis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rigs kyi lha mo sogs kyis gtsang lhag mchod gtor du bstab pa'i ras ma sngar gyi shul du bkod cing bdud rtsis bran la/ bh+yoḥ ke seng phra men sogs brjod mthar/ gtsang lhag gi ras ma de mang lhag tu phyir bsres/ phyag bcas/ lhag gtor byin gyis brlab cing bsngo ba la thugs gtad pa sogs zhu ba sngon 'gros/ slob dpon gyis mkha' dbyings kyi rgyas bkab par/ zhal chab tshul du bdud rtsis bran bzhin/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lhag ma'i dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur par

bsam pas brlab cing spel/ bshug pa'i brda dang 'bar ba'i rgyas e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ brjod pas mgron bkug /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐:bh+yo: dang po phud kyis sogs dmar lam gyis phye ste lhag ma btang*/ gong gi hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ nam mkha'i mkha' dang sogs nas/ dus la bab po sa ma yaḥ bar gyis dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang*/ hūm̐: phud kyis gsol lo sogs bka' srung mchod thabs mjug gi srung ma'i bskul bcas btang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus sogs kyi chad tho bsgrag /gtor zor dmigs bsal la ma gtogs rgyun du mi dgos pas/ bh+yo: bod khams sogs brtan ma nas/ rta bro'i mthar/ rjes kyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga nīrti hoḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ni bid+ya shab+da sarba pū dza hūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga ma hā dz+nyā na hoḥ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga sa man+ta pū dza hoḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ sta na ga ṇa ma hā su kha dhā tu a aḥ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: zhi khro'i sku ni gang 'dul nyams dang ldan: rdo rje dgyes pa sngags kyi rang sgra can: ye shes klong las yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dpal chen bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: rgyun gyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal chen zhi khro rdo rje'i g.yar dam can: bsnyen sgrub 'bras bu dus 'dir stsal nas kyang : thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bla med pas: sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol: spyi dril sham bur/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi rol/ nongs bshags ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang*/ yig brgya bzla/ tshogs mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol spyi ltar bya/ gang ltar yang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas/ bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐ sarba maṇ+ḍal sogs phrin las ltar brjod cing mnyam par bzhag /zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba ni/ slar yang 'gags med rig rtsal dpal chen po'i: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyur: ma hā shrī he ru ka āt+ma ko3haṃḥ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can rnams: phyi nang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal: bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin nas:

spyi dpal chen po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: smon lam gdab pa ni/ hoḥ phyogs dus rtsa brgyud sogs dri med kun dga'i zab gter las phyungs ba zur gsal ltar dang*/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ oṃḥ phun sum tshogs pa sogs zur gsal ltar sbyar bas 'grub bo/ /ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du karma pas spel ba dge/ //
